reference_platform.note: The vendored FLUS console is a macOS arm64 executable. GeoSpatial Kernel and GeoFM-LDN are Python code; a Linux rebuild requires a separately built FLUS binary.

determinism.randomness_note: NumPy, scikit-learn and PyTorch seeds are explicit. GPU/MPS runs may differ in the last floating-point bits; the reference comparison uses metric tolerances.
